text.date_limit: Reverse 5 ends in lacuna after royal name/title; year 06 is not independently recoverable from preserved formula shown. Month written iti {gesz}apin. Preserve catalogue date without inventing restoration.

recipients.uncertainty: Oil/unit in obverse 1 partly restored: [sila3 i3]-gesz

recipients.relationship: dam-a-ni (his wife), following sa6-ma-ar; grammatical interpretation, not a seal-ownership assertion

roles.caution: Royal a-ru-a and herding description preserved without resolving legal/social status. sipa is marked uncertain (#).

image_search.social_preview_caution: Generated social-preview URL is not proof of an available photograph; not treated as one.
image_search.publication_preview: Only limited front matter/content description accessible; no text 1354 or seal handcopy. Description says originals could not be photographed and volume 2 supplies transliterations; ancillary availability evidence, not proof no photograph exists anywhere.
image_search.bdtns_status: No external_resources in CDLI JSON; exact catalogue number not independently located in this bounded search.

anchor_assessment.conclusion: Useful Meluhha-person administrative evidence, but no verified name-to-Indus-sign anchor. Seal title is partly readable cuneiform and names are lost. Recipient identity is not owner identity.

comparison_limits: Repeated names and identical allocations in other texts do not alone prove duplicate physical tablet or same event.
CDLI gives SS06.03.00 here, unlike dates of cited Nisaba371/CUSAS1582/UCTIS099; parent reviews those records separately.
na-na-sa3 is retained literally; do not silently replace by Nanaza/na-na-za from another publication.
Surdi/De Graef 2025 note22 was the lead; this audit did not access its full article or attribute the seal to an Indus owner.
